Veeva’s Consultant Development Program (CDP) is an accelerated pathway that transforms early-career professionals into high-impact consultants who deliver cloud and AI solutions, helping global Life Sciences companies bring life-changing therapies to patients.

The Role

You’ll work hands-on with innovative technology, collaborating directly with internal teams and external customers, implementing our products to solve complex business challenges. In this role, you’ll learn our industry-leading cloud platforms and work with cutting-edge AI solutions to transform how life sciences companies operate. Empowered from day one by a team-first culture, you will accelerate your career growth as a technical consultant who thrives in an environment where we work hard for our customers and each other.

Start Date: July 2027

The Program

As part of the Consultant Development Program, you will:


Ramp up quickly. Your journey begins with an intensive, team-based onboarding program that combines hands-on learning, transparent feedback, and active collaboration to develop the consulting skills and industry knowledge to make an impact right away.
Learn by doing. You won't be watching from the sidelines. You will take on real responsibility and work directly with customers to solve problems within your first three months.
Thrive together. Grow alongside a supportive team of seasoned leaders and peers who actively champion your development through open communication and actionable feedback.
Build your future. Advance from Associate to Consultant in less than 2 years. More importantly, you’ll develop the foundation for a successful, long-term career where you can continually expand your technical expertise, lead complex projects, and evolve with our global and diverse team.


What You'll Do

As part of our Professional Services team, you are a strategic partner guiding customers through implementation. We will teach you how our software works, and you will use that knowledge to design, configure, and deliver solutions that drive real business value. Your day-to-day will involve:


Designing & tailoring the software: You will lead the configuration of our platform to fit each customer's unique business model—setting up workflows, structuring data, and aligning system capabilities to requirements.
Conducting discovery workshops: You will lead interactive discovery workshops with customer stakeholders to gather business requirements, map out existing workflows, and translate their vision into actionable technical specifications for deployment.
Managing project scope & execution: You will take ownership of core implementation deliverables by scoping requirements, building timeline estimates, and keeping project milestones on track from kick-off through go-live.
Guiding the customer as an expert: You will lead the customer with best practices to ensure their business processes are optimized for maximum long-term value on our products.


What We Are Looking For | We are open to graduates of a variety of backgrounds and look for a specific mindset:


Drive: You thrive in a challenging, intense environment that rewards initiative and rapid learning.
Curiosity: You have a genuine desire to be hands-on with software and master new technologies.
Communication: You are fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Analytical Mindset: You are a strong critical thinker with a proven track record of academic performance (in any degree/field of study).
Integrity: Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company and we expect that from all employees.
Work Ethic: A commitment to excellence and passion for working hard to achieve results.
Travel: Willingness to travel as needed (up to 20-30% of the time).
Experience: Recent bachelor’s or master’s degree graduate (up to 2 years postgraduate experience maximum)


How We Hire | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:


Apply: Submit your resume, a short cover letter, and take a quick personality test.
Fast Response: We will notify you of your next step typically within one week.
Interview & Case: Interview with a Veeva leader. If successful, we will give you a real-world scenario (with 3 days to prepare) to present to our team.
Offer: We make decisions quickly—usually within a week of your final presentation.


Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Starting Salary: $80,000 USD
Perform well, and in one year you’ll receive a compensation increase and participate in our bonus program.


Hybrid Work Environment: We require Associate Consultants to live within reasonable commuting distance from Veeva's Madison, Boston or New York office giving you easy access to in-person collaboration and support, skill development, and social opportunities as you launch your career. Long-term, our Work Anywhere policy allows you flexibility to work from the office or from your home.

Work Authorization: Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, OPT, or TN status) for this employment position.

#WU

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

Job Description

Business Analyst, Data & AI – Kearney Activate

About Kearney Activate

Kearney Activate is the business acceleration and enablement arm of Kearney Management Consulting, helping clients accelerate transformation through Data and AI.

Our Data & AI business line bridges strategy, technology, and execution to deliver data-driven, AI-enabled, and cloud-powered transformations. We partner with leading platforms such as Microsoft, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks and Nvidia to help organizations build trusted data foundations, deploy intelligent solutions, and scale innovation.

We Operate Across Four Key Focus Areas


Advisory & Assurance Services: Driving strategy, governance, and change management to ensure impactful transformation.
Data Services: Building trusted, high-quality data foundations using Agentic AI across engineering, architecture, and governance.
Insights Services: Unlocking value through analytics, data science, and AI-driven storytelling for better decision-making.
Asset Services: Developing reusable GenAI assets, accelerators, and AI-powered solutions that push the boundaries of innovation.


About The Role

As a Business Analyst within Kearney Activate, you will help translate business requirements into structured, actionable deliverables that support successful implementation and operational effectiveness. You will work closely with business stakeholders, SMEs, product owners, and technical teams in a fast-paced consulting environment.

Responsibilities


Support enterprise data and Master Data Management (MDM) transformation initiatives across process, data, and technology workstreams
Translate business discussions and stakeholder requirements into structured, high-quality business and functional deliverables
Develop content supporting various MDM request types and workflows
Maintain and update master data attribute files and related governance documentation
Ensure alignment between business process designs, system requirements, and UI/screens
Partner with SMEs, stakeholders, and design leads to gather, refine, and document requirements
Provide clear, actionable inputs to development teams responsible for system configuration and build activities
Support agile delivery activities including sprint planning, backlog refinement, testing coordination, and delivery tracking
Track key project metrics, business trends, and delivery progress
Support leadership in preparing materials for workshops, working sessions, and key decision meetings


Who You Are


4–7 years of experience in IT consulting, business analysis, data analysis, MDM, or related transformation roles
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail
Experience working in agile environments and cross-functional teams
Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, iterative delivery environments
Ability to independently manage deliverables and balance multiple priorities
Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills
Comfortable communicating with both business and technical stakeholders
Experience supporting enterprise data management or Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives preferred
Comfortable leveraging modern AI tools and technologies to drive efficiency and improve workflows


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or related field required
Experience with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics/reporting tools preferred
Familiarity with enterprise systems, workflow tools, and data governance processes preferred

Kearney reviews compensation regularly and may adjust base salaries to reflect market competitiveness. In addition to salary, individuals may be eligible for a discretionary performance bonus. Our full suite of benefits includes paid time off, paid sick leave, 401(k) match and profit sharing, medical, dental, and vision coverage, healthcare concierge services, backup child/adult care, annual employer HSA contributions, a home office stipend, subsidized gym membership, an annual wellness program, and leaves of absence when needed to support employees’ physical, mental, and emotional well-being.

ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

Insights & Analytics

ZS's Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.   

What You’ll Do


Serve as a day-to-day analytics partner supporting a leading biopharmaceutical organization's commercial and decision sciences teams.
Analyze large healthcare and pharmaceutical datasets, including claims, prescription, patient, and other secondary data sources, to generate actionable business insights.
Develop and maintain market performance tracking, brand performance reporting, KPI frameworks, and commercial analytics solutions that inform strategic decision-making.
Translate business questions into analytical approaches and deliver clear, data-driven recommendations to client stakeholders.
Work closely with client teams and cross-functional ZS colleagues to execute ongoing analytics programs and address evolving business needs.
Create dashboards, reports, and presentations that communicate key findings and support brand strategy development.
Partner with global team members to deliver high-quality analyses and ensure consistent execution across projects.
Support the development of scalable analytical solutions and best practices that enhance client impact.
Present insights and recommendations to both client and internal stakeholders.


What You’ll Bring


Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, economics, engineering, data science, mathematics, operations research, business analytics, or a related discipline.
2-5 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare analytics, life sciences consulting, or commercial analytics.
Hands-on experience working with commercial pharmaceutical data, including secondary data sources such as claims, prescription, patient-level, or other syndicated healthcare datasets.
Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercial analytics, including brand performance measurement, market landscape analyses, segmentation, KPI development, and business performance tracking.
Experience translating analytical findings into business recommendations for commercial stakeholders.
Advanced Excel skills and experience with analytical tools such as SQL, SAS, R, Python, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to effectively engage client audiences.
Ability to work independently in a client-facing environment while managing multiple priorities.


Preferred Qualifications


Prior consulting experience in a life sciences or healthcare-focused environment.
Experience supporting pharmaceutical commercial teams, including brand strategy, marketing, market access, sales operations, or decision sciences functions.
Experience working directly with client stakeholders in an embedded or highly collaborative model.


Location & Travel

Boston, MA. This role requires close collaboration with client stakeholders and regular on-site presence in the Boston area. Candidates should be comfortable working in a hybrid environment and traveling to client locations as needed.

How you’ll grow:

Shape the Future of Veterinary AI




At SignalPET, we're transforming veterinary medicine through artificial intelligence. Our cutting-edge technology combines computer vision, machine learning, and large language models to help veterinarians diagnose patients faster, more accurately, and with greater confidence.

Every day, our AI assists veterinary professionals around the world in making critical clinical decisions that improve patient care.




We're looking for an ambitious Data Scientist who is passionate about AI, thrives on solving complex problems, and wants to help build technology that truly makes a difference.

Whether you're a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, this is an opportunity to work alongside some of the brightest AI minds in the industry while contributing directly to products used by thousands of veterinary professionals.




Why Join SignalPET?




You'll work on real-world AI challenges—not theoretical projects.




As part of our AI team, you'll collaborate directly with our Chief AI Architect and experienced researchers, engineers, and veterinary specialists on projects involving:




Computer Vision
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Machine Learning
Prompt Engineering
AI Evaluation & Benchmarking

Data Science & Analytics

AI Infrastructure & Tooling




No two days are the same. You'll have the freedom to investigate problems, experiment with new technologies, and help shape the future of veterinary medicine through AI.




What You'll Do




As a Data Scientist, you'll play a key role throughout the AI development lifecycle by:




Analyzing large clinical, operational, textual, and medical imaging datasets to uncover meaningful insights.
Building reports, dashboards, and visualizations that guide product, research, and medical decisions.
Training, evaluating, and improving computer vision and large language models.

Supporting model training, fine-tuning, and continuous improvement.
Building tools that improve AI development, testing, and deployment.
Collaborating closely with engineers, researchers, product teams, and veterinary experts.
Presenting findings, recommendations, and technical insights in a clear, actionable manner.
Taking ownership of projects from concept through implementation.

Required Qualifications




Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Strong attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Large Language Models (LLMs)
Prompt Engineering
LLM Evaluation
Computer Vision

Experiment design and AI benchmarking
Data visualization and analytics platforms




Who Will Thrive Here?




We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys learning, and isn't afraid to tackle challenging problems.




You don't need experience with every technology listed above.

Instead, we're looking for someone who demonstrates:




Intellectual curiosity
Initiative and ownership
Strong analytical thinking
Creativity in problem solving
Adaptability
A passion for artificial intelligence
A desire to build technology that has real-world impact




If you're excited about AI, enjoy learning new technologies, and want to contribute to products used every day by veterinary professionals around the globe, we'd love to hear from you.

Career development and mentorship
Exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies

The opportunity to help improve the lives of veterinarians, pets, and their owners around the world




Ready to Build the Future of AI?




If you're looking for more than just another data science job if you want to solve meaningful problems, work with cutting-edge AI, and help shape the future of veterinary medicine, we'd love to hear from you.

At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist for MITRE’s Acquisition Affordability and Business Analytics Department within the MITRE Technology and Engineering Acquisition Division. Our team partners across the FFRDC and with government partners to solve complex mission and business challenges through advanced analytics, economic modeling, and decision support capabilities. Our work spans:


Cost Estimation and Analysis
Strategic Business & Financial Analytics
Investment Economics & Decision Analysis


MITRE is hiring experienced analysts to help expand and mature our business analytic and data science capability in support of a diverse set of internal and external sponsors. The work requires engagement with sponsors and multidisciplinary teams to frame analytic problems, identify and prioritize tasks, and report findings to support strategic and operational decision-making. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical thinking, intellectual curiosity, effective communication skills, and the ability to translate complex data into compelling insights that drive action and mission impact.

The role covers the full analytic lifecycle, including:


Identifying, sourcing, integrating, and validating complex datasets
Exploring and cleaning structured and unstructured data
Applying statistical methods, predictive models, and analytic techniques to derive insights from data
Interpreting findings within the context of relevant policies, regulations, budgets, and broader political or operational environments
Translating technical analyses into meaningful conclusions and recommendations for stakeholders
Developing analytic tools, dashboards, or reusable capabilities to support ongoing decision-making
Delivering findings through written reports, presentations, and in-person briefings to technical and non-technical audiences


In addition to core data science activities, this position supports broader department capabilities that apply analytic rigor to sponsor problems across cost, economic, and business domains. Work may include:


Life-cycle cost estimating
Tradeoff and affordability analyses
Decision analysis
Portfolio investment analysis
Business case analysis
Business intelligence and performance analytics


Candidates should expect a dynamic and collaborative environment where tasks are rarely routine and often require innovative and adaptive approaches. Successful team members are comfortable working across multiple projects simultaneously, operating with limited structure or supervision, and engaging directly with sponsors to solve complex, ambiguous problems.

Roles & Responsibilities:


Assist in identifying sources of information and gathering a wide range of quantitative and qualitative data to support decisions that have implications for MITRE and its government sponsors
Apply analysis skills, including exploratory data analysis, time series analysis, linear regression, text analysis, and machine learning
Draw conclusions from analyses and clearly and concisely articulate key findings in both written and verbal form
Assist in developing data visualization products that improve the presentation of complex data sets and analyses
Translate unstructured data and nontraditional sources of information into business insights
Support investment, economic, and decision analyses, including business case analyses, cost/benefit analyses, analysis-of- alternatives, and portfolio analysis
Support strategic business and financial analyses, including but not limited to economic studies, cost recovery strategies, budget development & planning, and affordability analysis
Assess government and industry cost estimates and economic analyses
Receives guidance, instruction, and direction from more senior staff while independently identifying and elevating relevant issues, risks, findings, or opportunities to senior team members.


Basic Qualifications:


Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree or 3 years and a Master's Degree in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Data Analytics, Data Science, Systems Engineering, or other engineering or quantitative analysis field
Proficient in python or R for data science and modeling
Proficient with code environment management and versioning (e.g.., Git, IDEs)
Ability to retrieve and work with data from remote data sources such as databases, APIs, and cloud-based data lakes using standard analytical tools and programming languages
Proficient in data processing, exploratory data analysis, and work with both structured and unstructured data sources
Proficient at machine learning and natural language processing, including model tuning, computer vision, time-series analysis, and related packages (e.g., scikit-learn)
Ability to leverage AI as a responsible augmentation to work, including judgement when to validate and tune LLM outputs
Experience with data visualization approaches and software, including PowerBI, Tableau, Qlik, and visual development through leaflet, R Shiny, plotly, seaborn, ggplot, or other packages
Proficient at use of statistical methods including regressions, forecasting, and hypothesis testing
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficient with MS Office Suite, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires a minimum of 4 days a week on-site


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Business, Operations Research, Data Analytics, Data Science, Systems Engineering, or other engineering field
Proficiency in additional programming languages including SQL or java
Familiarity with data engineering and orchestration methods (e.g., APIs, LLM endpoint management)
Familiarity with software engineering best practices and agile devops software development processes
Experience with econometric/economic modeling and analysis
Working knowledge of federal budgeting and spending mechanics, processes, and data.
Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) and OMB Circular A-11
Acquisition reform and PPBE reform initiatives
Federal Acquisition Regulations
Capital Planning and Investment Control (CPIC)
Federal spending data, including: USASpending.gov, SAM.gov, or FPDS-NG
Investment modeling and analysis, cost benefit analysis, experience in handling large datasets for data driven analysis, policy and investment analysis, and economic analysis in support of regulatory policy, pre- and post-implementation analysis, forecasting, and applied research
Expertise and experience with data engineering and cloud computing (i.e., Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure)
Cost estimating experience, including development of Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs) or use of parametric cost estimating tools (PRICE, SEER SEM, etc.)
Source selection cost evaluation experience

Mission Summary:

At Motional, we're transforming how autonomous vehicles discover critical intelligence hidden within petabytes of multimodal sensor data. Our next-generation autonomous driving stack depends on finding the rare edge cases, long-tail scenarios, and model errors that matter most. Omnitag, our ML-powered multimodal data mining framework, is the engine that powers this discovery.




As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Data Mining team, your mission is to help build the "Brain" of this engine. You will work with state-of-the-art foundation models to extract insights from Motional’s driving data, working at the intersection of large-scale representation learning and data retrieval. By building smarter mining tools and efficient data pipelines, you will accelerate the model improvement lifecycle for teams working on post-training analysis, error diagnosis, and dataset curation.




What You'll Do:

Build and Train ML Pipelines: Develop, train, and fine-tune machine learning models for multimodal sensor data (e.g., vision, LiDAR). Focus on implementing supervised and self-supervised learning approaches to improve data search and retrieval.
Support Model Deployment: Implement scalable data preprocessing and augmentation pipelines. Assist in applying standard optimization techniques (e.g., batch inference, quantization) to ensure models run efficiently in production environments.
Data Mining & Analysis: Help develop embedding-based search tools and "active learning" workflows to identify critical driving scenarios.
Monitor Production Performance: Help build and maintain dashboards to monitor model health, data drift, and system performance. Identify regressions and assist in the operational support of our data mining services.
Learn and Apply Best Practices: Follow software engineering standards (version control, CI/CD, unit testing) for ML code. Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation.
Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with senior engineers and machine learning engineers to translate model prototypes into maintainable, scalable engineering solutions.




What We're Looking For (Must-Haves):

BS or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow/JAX. You should be comfortable training models and evaluating them using standard metrics.
Strong proficiency in Python with the ability to write clean, modular, and well-documented code.
Working knowledge of version control, unit testing, and basic software design patterns.
Experience working with large datasets, including proficiency in SQL and data libraries like Pandas and NumPy.
A solid grasp of the full ML lifecycle, from data cleaning and feature engineering to validation and deployment basics.
A proactive learner who thrives on constructive feedback and is eager to grow within a high-stakes engineering environment.




Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

MS/PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
Experience with agentic systems, autonomous reasoning, chain-of-thought models, or LLM-based planning.
Background in autonomous driving, robotics, or real-time decision-making systems.
Familiarity with multimodal learning, sensor fusion, or embodied AI.
Experience building active learning loops, using the model to find the data that breaks the model.
Experience with ML-based data mining, active learning, or contrastive learning.
Knowledge of model serving tools (TF Serving, Triton, TorchServe) and MLOps platforms.
Publication in top-tier conferences (e.g., ICCV, CVPR, ECCV)




We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.

We value curiosity, creativity, collaboration, and expertise, continuously striving to push boundaries and exceed our clients' expectations. Join us to be part of a culture that drives meaningful results.

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a data analyst with a minimum of three years’ experience to clean, structure and process data from primary market research. An understanding of quantitative marketing research techniques, tools, processes, and procedures is preferred. Experience in primary market research is required. You must have strong interpersonal and organizational skills and be detail-oriented, flexible and above all, collaborative. The range of duties includes enforcing data quality control protocols, cleaning and structuring data sets, generating data cross tabulations and conducting a variety of analytical procedures.

In this role, you will be working closely with the Sr. Director of Custom Research, various Research Managers, the Director of Marketing Sciences, fellow Data Analysts and various Publishing department personnel.

What You'll Do


Clean and structure complex data sets in SPSS/alternate platforms, including AI-based apps
Analyze/interpret results using common statistical techniques in SPSS and other programs as assigned
Produce client-friendly data cross-tabulations in WinCross, JMP and alternate platforms, including our in-house survey platform, MarketOnce
Perform various quality assurance tasks, including QA on in-progress surveys
Develop and maintain databases/data systems

3+ years of relevant experience as a data analyst/data processor with a track record of high performance
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to plan, prioritize, manage, and effectively deliver on multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment
Understanding of market research processes highly desired

Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy

Opportunity for career progression with plenty of room for personal growth

Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Who We Are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What We Do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

CarGurus is seeking a Business Analytics Analyst to join the Business Analytics & Reporting team. This team is responsible for the analytical rigor behind reporting, forecasting, and financial modeling that enable day-to-day and strategic decisions. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious and an exceptional critical thinker; they can live in the data, understanding the logic and processes that generate it as well as detecting signals, diagnosing problems, proposing solutions, and predicting future behavior. They can then use their mastery to synthesize and convey important information to other parties and offer thoughtful ways in which things can be improved.

The Business Analytics Team has a wide remit at CarGurus. You’ll work with many departments, gaining a broad exposure to the operation of the business, and be asked to connect the dots between them. Your rich understanding, technical skills, and thought partnership will make you a highly sought-after contributor for a wide variety of stakeholders, including senior leaders.

What You'll Do


With the assistance of AI tools, conduct exploratory data analysis across disparate data sources to understand the performance of the business and identify potential opportunities and/or risks.
Be an active contributor in discussions with decision-makers, using cognitive empathy to understand their vantage point and incentives before using this understanding to structure and frame downstream work and resulting findings.
Use data to identify, validate, and uncover causal relationships of important business mechanisms.
Implement new metrics to evaluate business performance and/or experiments and build reports and dashboards to monitor and understand them.
Be a voice and advocate to use data to improve the quality of our decision-making.


What You'll Bring


BS or BA in computer science, mathematics, statistics, analytics, or economics, with equivalent analytical work experience or a MS degree in a relevant field of study.
2+ years of professional experience focused on analysis and reporting, including the use of data visualization tools, to influence understanding and decision-making.
Ability to understand systems and business goals to help modernize and innovate on present data structures and models.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, using hypothesis-driven analysis to solve questions and give guidance.
Fluent in SQL and an analytical tool; experience with Git, Python, and LLMs is a plus.
Some experience with data modeling and ETL concepts.
Proficient at working with data ambiguity to derive meaningful insights.
Excellent verbal, interpersonal, and written communication skills.
Able to manage multiple projects effectively, set expectations with partners, and complete projects on time.

Working at CarGurus

We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives.

CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate.

We welcome all

CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus.
